chapter: Germany, Buck's death and ideas about life
title: If Buck were alive; marijuana, Louis Armstrong and Joe Glaser
summary: He says he would be active with Buck now that marijuana is nearly legal, and tells of Louis Armstrong's arrest being handled by Joe Glaser.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you think if Buck were still alive you would be more active in entertainment, do you think you would be doing things together today?
Oh, yeah, because I'd be able now, since I've gotten out of the

mind that I had concerning these old friends of his that he used to hang out with and the character because they have almost legalized what they prosecuted him for. That's almost a legalization thing now. And it's disgraceful when you think people had to go and serve time in jail and all for that and the days going to be free for nothing. That's a disgrace.
And look what they did to Louis Armstrong. That's the first one they caught doing that and they sure persecuted him.

Well, he's the first one out here in California that they caught with the marijuana and they found him plus he was obligated to Joe Glaser for getting him out of the difficulty and Joe Glaser greased that one a bit to get him out when everything would have been hushed over.* That's how they got out.

Naturally, if you do me a favor I'm obligated to you. If you do me a favor I'm obligated. That was a terrible thing then, smoking marijuana. And at that time they made it bad -- so bad that they don't want you doing nothing but serve time for doing it. So if Joe Glaser can keep him out of jail and squash it down I think I'd be indebted to him, too. Why wouldn't you? Well, that's what will happen. But Louis Armstrong paid the price for that. Then comes Charlie Barnet, then comes the rest of them. Benny Goodman is the only one I think they didn't catch. You know? Caught quite a lot of them. But they paid for it.

They got Count Basie, they got some of his men out of his band, quite a few they got -- marijuana and it's now almost a legalized drug. Just shows to go ya, what the world turns out to be. It's terrible, the world is in a bad state.
